name: Silicon (Si-I, diamond cubic)
notes: The lattice parameter is calculated from the fitted 300 K atomic reference volume. PhaseSmith calculates powder reflections and intensities from the ideal diamond structure.

eos_records.label: Anzellini et al. (2019), constrained Vinet
eos_records.notes: Figure 1 constrained Vinet fit with K0' fixed to the ultrasonic value; published V0=20.031 A^3/atom is multiplied by eight atoms in the conventional diamond cell. Si-I was observed to 13.9 GPa under quasi-hydrostatic compression. The publication does not quote individual statistical uncertainties for this constrained fit.
